unlisted_practices: Multi-agent LLM workflow that autonomously generates DSM-5 Level-1 questionnaires via simulated therapist-client dialogues
Step-by-step explainable disorder predictions for mental health diagnosis

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel multi-agent LLM workflow (DSM5AgentFlow) for mental disorder diagnosis and simulated dialogues, evaluating performance on accuracy, realism, and explainability without testing a real-world deployment practice or safeguard.
